req.title: Session persists across requests
req.statement: The system shall keep session['user_id'] populated across requests until logout for authenticated users.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the session should persist across requests for authenticated users until logout. This involves ensuring that the session['user_id'] is maintained correctly. The tests will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_session_persists_after_login
preconditions: User is registered in the system
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Log in
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

# Access a protected resource
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Posts' in r.data

tests.name: test_session_cleared_after_logout
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and log in
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Log out
r = client.get('/auth/logout')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

# Attempt to access a protected resource
r = client.get('/create')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert '/auth/login' in r.headers['Location']

tests.name: test_session_persistence_boundary
preconditions: User is registered and logged in
actions: Access a protected resource multiple times
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and log in
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Access a protected resource multiple times
for _ in range(3):
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Posts' in r.data
